name: LLVM Project
problems: large monorepo (LLVM core, Clang, LLD, libc++, and more combined) leads to long build times from source
source_notes: Collection of modular, reusable compiler and toolchain technologies (LLVM core, Clang C/C++ frontend, LLD linker, libc++). Originated at UIUC in 2000. Licensed under Apache License 2.0 with LLVM Exceptions.
